exposure: ELISA positivity for Hepatitis B Virus (HBV)
ELISA positivity for Hepatitis C Virus (HCV)
ELISA positivity for Human Immunodeficiency Virus (HIV)
cohort: The study included 380 ELISA-positive and 294 ELISA-negative pregnant women admitted to the delivery room unit of Kanuni Sultan Suleyman Training and Research Hospital between January 2014 and December 2014.
finding: The rates of fetal growth restriction (FGR), gestational hypertension (GHT), and increased pregnancy loss were significantly higher in the ELISA-positive group compared to the ELISA-negative group, and their average birth weight was significantly lower.
mod_finding: No statistically significant differences were observed between the ELISA-positive and ELISA-negative groups regarding delivery method.
